title: The Infinite Pattern Divergence

features.name: the-splitting-warp
features.desc-on-touch: Where one thread enters, many threads exit. The archive shows you a branching loom: each pass multiplies, each colour learns what it means to diverge into its own cousin-shades.

features.name: the-choice-marks
features.desc-on-touch: Notches where each decision was made: which pattern to hold, which to release. The archive keeps them all, none erased.

features.name: the-echo-pattern
features.desc-on-touch: A rhythm that repeats but never identically. Each loop alters by the memory of what came before. You hear it shift under your fingers as you listen.

features.name: the-thread-count-impossible
features.desc-on-touch: A ledger that was never written. The archive tries to count the threads at the split-point, but the sum changes each time it tallies—there is always one more thread than moments ago.

features.name: the-furthest-reach
features.desc-on-touch: At the edge of the splitting, the patterns get so fine they touch silence. Here the threads are thinner than observation. You feel them more than see them.
